description: This file provides functions for managing and mapping environment variable templates for different frameworks, including loading YAML configuration files, applying prefixes, and performing variable mappings between common and framework-specific environment variable sets.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the path to the environment template file for the specified framework.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file to extract optional prefix and environment variable mapping.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Prefixes all environment variables in a dictionary with a given prefix.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a set of common environment variables into framework-specific variables based on the template's mappings and prefix.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts framework-specific environment variables back into the common variable set based on the template's mappings and prefix.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Returns a list of supported frameworks by detecting directories containing an 'env.template' file.

ctags.name: apply_prefix_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_common_to_framework
ctags.pattern: /^def map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_framework_to_common
ctags.pattern: /^def map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
